name: Kimi API Platform
description: Serves Moonshot AI's Kimi models through OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions, Responses, and Anthropic-compatible Messages APIs, with tool calling, web search, and a 1M-token context.

skills.name: Tool Calling
skills.description: Defines and executes tool_calls, including in streaming mode, with tool_choice and dynamically loaded tool definitions.

skills.name: Web Search
skills.description: Adds web search through the built-in $web_search tool or the search and URL-fetch tool endpoints.

skills.name: File-Based Q&A
skills.description: Uploads files, extracts their content, and adds them to conversations for single- or multi-file questions.

skills.name: Batch Processing
skills.description: Runs large asynchronous jobs from uploaded JSONL requests and downloads the results.

skills.name: Context Caching
skills.description: Caches repeated prompt prefixes with 5-minute or 1-hour TTLs to cut cost and latency.
